unit: One owning command plan; retries charged independently; no cross-Company mixed write
counting: All counts checked integer arithmetic; charge before allocation/read/lock/effect. Metadata encoding and counting rules must be implemented by fixed registered decoder before admission.

Materialized limits include input-derived and server-derived nodes, query witnesses, protected inventory roots and all purpose edges. Exact identity dedup preserves purpose edges; no cross-tenant/digest-only dedup.

Covered counters include all transitively protected evidence even if not read now; conservative summed child counters may overcount sharing and must never undercount. No metadata-only root may hide unbounded bytes.
Fresh external bytes sums all original/derivative/package bytes fetched for command; building preparation does not exempt its own budgets. Existing19 smaller per-file limits always apply.

No leaf bypass: referenced sealed inventory admission must demonstrate exhaustive closure, protected contents and authoritative lifecycle membership, not just counters. Missing this capability forces explicit expansion within limits or blocks enrollment.
8192 reverse rows plus one overflow sentinel is allowed for protection lookup; overflow/unknown prohibits destructive action, never treats remaining rows as absent.

Whole plan overflow refuses effect before locks/effects; preserve acknowledged input and authorized typed blocker/repair route. No silent truncation, manual splitting of atomic work, operator override or automatic retry storm. Reviewed widening or existing native18 bounded unit workflow only.
No new deadline promise from row limits. Query plan/statement, transaction duration and memory/p95/p99 proof remain F08 with deployment sizing.
